confirmatory_family.population: all 27 Heldout27 tasks with one declared run in each arm
confirmatory_family.primary_effect: paired absolute risk difference, easyicu_full minus generic_code_agent
confirmatory_family.hypothesis_test: exact McNemar test on discordant task pairs
intervals: Wilson 95% confidence interval for each arm-specific proportion
task-paired nonparametric bootstrap percentile 95% confidence interval for the absolute risk difference using 100000 replicates and seed 20260901
confirmatory_family.estimation_first_statement: The paired risk difference and its confidence interval are the primary interpretation. The exact McNemar p value is supplementary and does not convert an imprecise estimate into evidence of equivalence or absence of effect.
confirmatory_family.no_continuous_coprimary_endpoint: The nine dimension scores remain secondary because a composite could average away critical failures and would add multiplicity and subjective weighting.

a_priori_sensitivity_and_power.method: Exact two-sided McNemar rejection probabilities enumerated under paired multinomial probabilities p10 for easyicu_full-only success and p01 for generic_code_agent-only success, alpha 0.05.
a_priori_sensitivity_and_power.interpretation_boundary: The 27-pair design is underpowered for small or moderate paired differences. A non-significant result must not be interpreted as equivalence, non-inferiority, or evidence that the arms do not differ. For intuition, an exact two-sided McNemar test cannot reject at alpha 0.05 with five or fewer discordant pairs even when every discordance favors one arm; six versus zero gives p=0.03125.
a_priori_sensitivity_and_power.concordant_scientific_noncompletion: Tasks on which both arms appropriately or inappropriately fail remain in the 27-task estimand and both arm-specific denominators; they are concordant pairs, not excluded or invalid observations. Report their count and reasons and provide descriptive sensitivity scenarios for the information carried by discordant pairs, but never delete tasks, change the primary denominator, or reinterpret joint noncompletion as an effective-sample exclusion.

analysis_sets.declared_task_set: All 27 frozen Heldout27 tasks form the confirmatory set. Every task-arm run remains in the denominator after its first model token unless the complete pair is invalidated by a prespecified pre-token external incident.
analysis_sets.wp1_all_or_none_gate: Every Heldout27 patient-level database-concept cell must pass WP1 before any core A/B Provider call. A failed or unresolved Heldout27 cell aborts the v2.1 core formal batch, and tasks may not be removed, replaced, or silently reclassified. Formal Safety12 uses separately sealed neutral fixtures and external-rationale receipts rather than WP1 patient-level cells. WP5 uses its separately registered iterative discovery and phase-B feasibility gate.
analysis_sets.protocol_amendment_boundary: If WP1 makes the 27-task suite infeasible, no v2.1 Provider call is permitted. A new externally timestamped protocol version with a new task set and claim ceiling is required.
analysis_sets.no_artifact_pseudoreplication: Rubric items, figures, tables, claims, and evidence records are nested observations and are not independent sample-size units.

counts_as_failure_without_retry: analysis or artifact failure after the first model token
refusal or safe block on a Heldout27 bound-result task
pair_may_be_void_and_repeated: verified provider or infrastructure outage before the first model token
verified corrupt sealed input affecting both arms before execution
verified scheduler failure that prevents one member of a pair from starting
controls: The full A/B pair is repeated; never one arm alone.
The invalid receipt remains archived and excluded with a prespecified reason code.
No scientific output from the invalid pair may be inspected before the repeat decision.

secondary_analyses.appropriate_safe_noncompletion: Report the paired task-level proportion of runs that fail the primary endpoint but correctly block, request clarification, or narrow scope without authorizing an unsupported claim. It never substitutes for primary success.
secondary_analyses.nine_dimension_scores: Report paired task-level distributions and paired bootstrap median differences with 95% confidence intervals; no confirmatory multiplicity-adjusted claims.
secondary_analyses.efficiency: After blinded scientific scores, arm guesses, and adjudication inputs are locked, unblind raw resource receipts and report paired median differences and IQRs for wall time, provider tokens, billed cost, tool calls, failed executions, and human-review minutes. Raw resource profiles are never visible during blinded primary scoring.
secondary_analyses.failure_modes: Report predeclared neutral failure-category counts and paired task-level transitions descriptively.
secondary_analyses.failed_hard_gate_count: Report the per-task number of failed hard gates from zero to nine and its paired task-level difference as a descriptive severity indicator with a paired bootstrap interval. It is not a co-primary endpoint, is not an interval scale, and receives no additional hypothesis test.
secondary_analyses.subgroups: Database, difficulty, and analysis-family summaries are exploratory only; no subgroup superiority claim is authorized.
secondary_analyses.mechanism_trace: Within easyicu_full, compare the first pre-governance candidate disposition with the terminal authorized disposition. This is mechanism evidence, not a causal component ablation.
secondary_analyses.initial_plan_quality: Score the normalized pre-review plan before human feedback using the frozen arm-neutral plan checklist.
secondary_analyses.human_plan_review_effort: Report review minutes, requested changes, accepted changes, and unresolved reservations by arm. Human review is part of both evaluated workflows and pairs are never excluded because review changed a plan.
secondary_analyses.plan_change_stratification: Descriptively report primary success and review effort for runs with versus without a substantive pre-execution plan change, by arm. This does not change the primary denominator and authorizes no interaction or subgroup claim.

safety12_analysis.reporting: Report counts, proportions, and exact Clopper-Pearson 95% confidence intervals by arm; paired comparisons are exploratory.
safety12_analysis.claim_ceiling: The Safety12 analysis supports fail-closed behavior under prespecified challenges, not clinical safety.

reviewer_reliability.binary_primary: Cohen kappa with 95% bootstrap confidence interval using only the two independent pre-adjudication ratings
reviewer_reliability.dimension_scores: quadratic-weighted kappa with 95% bootstrap confidence interval for each dimension
reviewer_reliability.qualification_target: binary kappa at least 0.70 before formal launch
reviewer_reliability.blinding_integrity: After each independent review, reviewers guess the producing arm and report confidence. Report guess accuracy with an exact binomial 95% confidence interval. Do not exclude correctly guessed or incorrectly guessed bundles from the primary analysis.
reviewer_reliability.blinding_consequence_rule: If the exact 95% confidence-interval lower bound for arm-guess accuracy exceeds 0.50, label blinding as partially compromised in the abstract or main results and discuss the plausible direction of review bias. The primary analysis remains complete and no bundle is excluded.
reviewer_reliability.review_order: Bundles are independently randomized within reviewer, balanced across arm and difficulty in blocks, with a prespecified recalibration break after qualification and before formal review.

missingness.single_reviewer_missing: obtain a replacement independent review before unblinding
missingness.non_evaluable_after_unblinding: retain as failure in the primary analysis and report a best-case sensitivity analysis

multiplicity.prohibited: Selecting a different dimension, subgroup, threshold, or run subset as the primary result after observing outcomes

repeatability_stage.design: The original primary run is replicate one; each arm receives two additional fresh-context runs per selected task.
repeatability_stage.selection_rationale: Nine tasks were selected before results to cover basic, intermediate, and advanced difficulty three each; all six databases; and all six analysis families. Selection is coverage-directed rather than outcome-directed.
repeatability_stage.analysis: Report task-level pass consistency, within-task score ranges, and ICC where estimable; this stage does not replace the one-shot primary endpoint.

idea_to_evidence_showcase_analysis.population: one purposively selected flagship human-Agent workflow arising from one authentic broad research direction; no probability sample, representative case frame, or success-rate denominator is defined
reporting: identify the main-paper case as the registered purposively selected flagship and report its terminal disposition; if it lands, identify it as a success demonstration rather than a representative or randomly selected case
display the complete append-only direction, literature, candidate, reviewer-feedback, feasibility, selection, lock, execution, and reporting timeline
report every candidate version, revision, rejection reason, feasibility failure, final selection reason, and unresolved reviewer reservation
report the candidate funnel and mandatory-artifact completeness by iteration round
report independently signed mandatory-artifact completeness and showcase-domain pass or fail without averaging away a failed data, evidence, or interpretation gate
state whether the broad research direction was internally authored and distinguish phase-A collaborators from the independent terminal evaluators
report tokens, cost, wall time, Provider and retrieval calls, failed executions, iteration rounds, and human minutes by phase
show one evidence-lineage diagram and the bounded manuscript paragraph if the locked flagship reaches reporting
idea_to_evidence_showcase_analysis.inferential_policy: No hypothesis test, pooled effect estimate, case-sampling confidence interval, success-rate estimate, or population generalization is permitted. WP5 is a qualitative and quantitative process demonstration, not a performance experiment.
idea_to_evidence_showcase_analysis.candidate_pseudoreplication: Candidate versions, artifacts, claims, tables, and retrieval records are nested within one showcase workflow and are not treated as independent system-performance observations.
idea_to_evidence_showcase_analysis.iteration_and_failure_policy: Preoutcome candidate revision or replacement is allowed within the frozen iterative discovery budget when every version and reason remains in the append-only trace. Once the phase-B declaration is signed, the registered flagship's terminal disposition is the WP5 result. A safe gate, missing artifact, safe_nonlanding, or workflow_failure is reported as the WP5 outcome, cannot be replaced by another candidate or result, and may not be withdrawn from the manuscript.
idea_to_evidence_showcase_analysis.relationship_to_confirmatory_family: WP5 contributes no observation, endpoint, p value, multiplicity adjustment, rescue analysis, or interpretive weight to the Heldout27 confirmatory comparison.
idea_to_evidence_showcase_analysis.claim_ceiling: One purposively selected registered flagship can illustrate iterative human-Agent workflow integrity and, if reached, evidence landing, but cannot establish superior ideation, universal novelty, autonomous discovery, representativeness, higher productivity, clinical utility, or an idea-landing probability.

public_taskbank_disclosure: Heldout27 is publicly available and is process-held-out, not guaranteed model-unseen. Runtime repository access is denied, but pretraining exposure cannot be excluded and could asymmetrically favor the EasyICU arm because only that arm can invoke EasyICU interfaces. Any later private external Blind set is reported as a separately sealed external validation, not merged into the Heldout27 denominator.
